in_hebrew.name: Josafina
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Josafina הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Hebrew name Yo'safat, meaning 'God has healed', or the Greek name Iosaphē, meaning 'God has saved'. Josafina is a popular name among Christians, particularly in honor of Saint Josaphat (1581-1623), a Ukrainian monk and bishop.

in_latin.name: Josaphina
in_latin.meaning: Feminine form of Joseph, derived from Hebrew name Yosef, meaning God will add, a symbol of divine providence.
in_latin.long_meaning: Josaphina, the feminine form of Joseph, is a name derived from the Hebrew name Yosef, meaning God will add. This name symbolizes divine providence, emphasizing God's role in guiding and adding to our lives. In the context of the early Christian church, the name Joseph is significant, as Joseph of Arimathea is mentioned in the New Testament as the one who provided the tomb for Jesus' burial (Matthew 27:57-60). The name Josaphina reflects the Christian tradition of seeking divine guidance and provision.
